ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-10-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Joyce Long.
Petitioner: Sybrina Bisbee: , present in pro per as Guardians ad litem for the Minor: Mekai Leema Springs.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing. An application and declaration in support of order dispensing notice and order thereon was filed in open court.`
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: MEKAI LEENA BISBEE.

Decree signed in open court.
